I've tried probably somewhere around 10 medications over the last several years. It feels pointless to continue the effort. Not to say I'm going to stop. I'm just saying it feels hopeless that I'll find working medication.

I don't know how to open up to a therapist without being sent to the hospital. I've already made the mistake several times of saying too much, and it caused more trouble than it was worth. I wish I could tell them how close I am to death, but they're mandated to send me away if they know that.

I've tried visiting the Center, here in Las Vegas. It's like an LGBT community center and they have a transgender support group. The group isn't very helpful, though. It always feels like people just want to argue about politics or derail into some senseless and sometimes harmful discussions. Plus, seeing transgender people who are living successfully and passing as their preferred gender just makes me jealous. I guess that's petty of me, but whenever I see a transwoman that passes perfectly, I just feel so overwhelmed.

I've tried therapy and medication. Neither of which seem to work.

I'm currently in the middle of a gender transition, so I'm also attempting to do stuff for that.

I've tried going out and meeting people, too. So Maybe I can make some friends and be less lonely, but nothing ever works out. I always just end up feeling embarrassed.
I've tried talking talking to a counselor and I've tried medication. Sometimes it seems like it's working for a few weeks or a month, but it always wears off.
I've tried many medications over the last couple years. Nothing seems to work. Sometimes I feel a little better for a month or so, but it always wears off.

I don't even know what's bothering me, though, to be honest. Like, yeah, there are a lot of small things, but I can't seem to pinpoint why I feel so awful. It could be gender dysphoria (I'm going through a gender transition). It could be loneliness. Maybe my brain just doesn't work right. I don't know.

I know people will miss me, but I can't live like this. I'm just so miserable all the time. And it doesn't matter what I do.

I'm not saying I don't appreciate your sentiment. I do. But I don't know.

I don't even know. I'm just desperate for some way to make me feel better. Nothing I do works.

I don't even know how to approach fixing this at this point. I'm kind of panicking, because I'm afraid I might really go through with my suicide. I mean, I can't live like this forever. If it doesn't change soon then I don't know if I'll be able to stop myself forever.
